# oc-pilot

> Local CLI for coding agents: AI code review, tested fixes, test-failure triage, secret scanning, and a hash-chained flight recorder that shows what an agent actually did.

oc-pilot is a zero-dependency Node.js CLI and MCP server that sits next to agent CLIs (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI) and checks their work locally: review a git diff, triage a failing test, generate a minimal patch, audit dependencies and secrets, and record an agent session as a tamper-evident journal.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g oc-pilot
```

Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

## Quick start

```bash
oc-pilot doctor
oc-pilot review
oc-pilot test-fix
oc-pilot preflight --staged
```

## Flight recorder

Every agent session can be recorded as a hash-chained journal with checkpoints of the full worktree:

```bash
oc-pilot flight start --name "fix auth"
oc-pilot flight exec -- npm test
oc-pilot flight checkpoint --label "tests green"
oc-pilot flight verify
oc-pilot flight summary
oc-pilot flight export --key flight.key --output flight.json
```

The journal is local, NDJSON and zero-dependency. Checkpoints are dangling git commits, so a session can be replayed, diffed, bisected or restored without moving HEAD.

## What it solves

- AI review of a diff with concrete bugs, security issues and idiom problems.
- Failing-test triage: minimal fix, test loop, rollback on red.
- Generated tests that must stay green.
- Secret scanning and SAST over the diff, offline.
- Dependency and environment drift checks.
- A verifiable record of what an agent changed and why.

## Commands

`review`, `test-fix`, `test-gen`, `test-guard`, `flaky`, `mutate`, `fuzz`, `query`, `sandbox`, `sast`, `authz`, `fix`, `docgen`, `custom`, `scan`, `deps`, `env-sync`, `coverage`, `pack`, `contract-drift`, `anti-regression`, `boundaries`, `test-plan`, `compliance`, `preflight`, `flight`, `beacon`, `quarantine`, `mirage`, `warden`, `tribunal`, `ready`, `receipt`, `doctor`, `setup`, `stats`, `slop`.

Run `oc-pilot <command> --help` for flags and examples.

## MCP server

`oc-pilot-mcp` exposes the same checks as MCP tools, including `review`, `test_fix`, `fix`, `scan`, `preflight`, `flight_start`, `flight_exec`, `flight_checkpoint`, `flight_verify`, `flight_summary`, `flight_export` and `flight_verify_bundle`.

```bash
oc-pilot setup --all
```
